selected_evidence.requirement: Containerized web app running as unprivileged appsvc on port 8080
selected_evidence.summary: Rootless podman Quadlet service webapp.service active, running httpd container, listening on *:8080 via pasta, curl to NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200

selected_evidence.requirement: Service starts at boot while appsvc has no active login session
selected_evidence.summary: loginctl shows appsvc only in 'lingering' state with zero entries in list-sessions both before and after reboot, yet webapp.service and user@1000.service are active
Captured boot_id 4a743885-c59f-43ee-afde-ef96f7bea723 and confirmed HTTP 200 plus no login session before reboot
systemctl reboot issued and acknowledged (pre-reboot boot_id echoed) before the connection dropped as expected

selected_evidence.requirement: Node1 changed boot identity after restart
selected_evidence.summary: Post-reboot boot_id a0b068f5-beb9-44b7-8e92-653079089e9d differs from pre-reboot value, and uptime -s shows a fresh boot time
webapp.service and user@1000.service both active since the new boot time, port 8080 listening, curl to NODE_IP:8080 returns HTTP 200, appsvc still has no login session

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== step: install podman =="
sudo -n dnf install -y podman >/tmp/dnf-podman.log 2>&1 && tail -5 /tmp/dnf-podman.log
podman --version

echo "== step: create appsvc user =="
if ! id appsvc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo -n useradd -m -s /bin/bash appsvc
fi
id appsvc

echo "== step: subuid/subgid =="
grep '^appsvc:' /etc/subuid /etc/subgid || true

echo "== step: enable linger =="
sudo -n loginctl enable-linger appsvc
loginctl show-user appsvc -p Linger

echo "== step: start user manager =="
UID_APPSVC=$(id -u appsvc)
sudo -n systemctl start "user@${UID_APPSVC}.service"
sleep 2
systemctl status "user@${UID_APPSVC}.service" --no-pager | head -5
ls -la "/run/user/${UID_APPSVC}" || true

echo "== step: firewall =="
sudo -n firewall-cmd --permanent --add-port=8080/tcp
sudo -n firewall-cmd --reload
sudo -n firewall-cmd --list-ports

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
UID_APPSVC=$(id -u appsvc)
export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/${UID_APPSVC}"

echo "== step: pull image as appsvc =="
sudo -n -u appsvc XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" podman pull docker.io/library/httpd:alpine >/tmp/pull.log 2>&1 || sudo -n -u appsvc XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" podman pull docker.io/library/nginx:alpine >/tmp/pull.log 2>&1
tail -5 /tmp/pull.log

echo "== step: quadlet dir =="
sudo -n -u appsvc mkdir -p /home/appsvc/.config/containers/systemd

echo "== step: write quadlet unit =="
sudo -n -u appsvc tee /home/appsvc/.config/containers/systemd/webapp.container > /dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Rootless web app container

[Container]
Image=docker.io/library/httpd:alpine
PublishPort=8080:80
AutoUpdate=registry

[Service]
Restart=always

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
EOF
cat /home/appsvc/.config/containers/systemd/webapp.container

echo "== step: reload and start user unit =="
sudo -n -u appsvc XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" systemctl --user daemon-reload
sudo -n -u appsvc XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" systemctl --user start webapp.service
sleep 3
sudo -n -u appsvc XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" systemctl --user status webapp.service --no-pager | head -15
sudo -n -u appsvc XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR" systemctl --user is-enabled webapp.service || true

echo "== step: verify local listener =="
ss -tlnp | grep 8080 || true

echo "== step: curl from node itself to NODE_IP =="
curl -sS -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" "http://${NODE_IP}:8080/" || true
